stations.title: The API
stations.text: Reads and creates, but changes nothing.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: No way to change or remove

captions: Nadia has three changes this week, and glazing basics is cancelled.
The API can add workshops but not change or remove one, so glazing stays on the page.
You add PUT, PATCH and DELETE, each checking the id first and the body second.
Glazing is removed, and the other two changes are saved.
Workshops can now change all week, and the page always shows what really runs.
